claims.statement: `finalizarCompra` requires an authenticated user, applies a five-per-minute per-user checkout limit, verifies Turnstile, validates cart/payment input shape, and repeats server-side eligibility checks for Mercado Futuro and perishable-product acceptances before creating orders.

The authenticated `SECURITY DEFINER` `checkout_criar_pedido` RPC is the authoritative per-store order transaction: it locks and validates products/store/quantities/stock, calculates authoritative prices, freight and coupon effects, inserts an `Aguardando Pagamento` order and line items with allocation fields, decrements stock, and records expiring inventory reservations.

Checkout supports PIX, boleto, and credit-card billing; Asaas charge creation uses the authoritative order amount and order ID as `externalReference`, while hosted invoice URLs keep card data outside the application.

Charge creation is intentionally best-effort after durable order creation and uses conditional charge-ID persistence to prevent duplicate live charges under concurrent attempts; a losing attempt tries to cancel its gateway charge, and buyers can retry charge generation only for their own order.

The Asaas webhook authenticates with a constant-time token comparison and, for paid events, accepts payment only when both the stored charge ID matches and the event amount is at least the order amount before marking the order and all its line items paid.

Buyer-triggered manual payment verification is a rate-limited ownership-checked fallback for missing or delayed webhooks; shared confirmation uses `dt_pagamento` and a conditional null-only write to ensure only the first concurrent confirmation performs payment effects.

Gateway cancellation events invoke a service-role-only cancellation RPC which only cancels orders still awaiting payment and restores stock; manual seller/admin cancellation requires a reason, is forbidden after `Enviado`, restores stock, clears eligible payment flags, marks pending payout ledger entries reversed, and does not perform an Asaas refund.

Payment confirmation attempts WhatsApp notifications for the buyer's pickup/delivery code and seller's paid-order notice, buyer email, and delivery dispatch after persistence; these notification and routing side effects are best-effort and do not invalidate payment confirmation.

Delivery completion is stored per line in `entregas`, not as an additional order status; authenticated store/eligible logistics actors and a public carrier route can confirm a paid order with the buyer code, with idempotent success and incorrect-code attempt limits.

Delivery confirmation recalculates and hands off pending seller or affiliate payouts, while a seller may request the same payout flow once paid; a null-only `pendente` to `processando` claim prevents duplicate Asaas PIX transfers, ineligible recipients become `inelegivel`, and transfer failures become `falhou` without reversing delivery or the request.

`estoque_reservas` records normal or future-sale stock reserved by an awaiting-payment order with a 30-minute expiry; cancellation/expiry releases active or confirmed reservations idempotently, payment confirms them, and shipment or complete per-line delivery consumes them without another stock decrement.

`montagem-pedido` is a tested pure boundary that preserves cart encounter order when grouping by store, includes carrier and Uber quote IDs only for delivery, applies a shared checkout reference to coupon payloads, and validates Mercado Futuro document/terms gates.
Focused tests cover checkout schemas and payment methods, freight selection, webhook-token comparison, status email content, and pure per-store order-payload assembly.
